3 26-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel for the informant.
2. In the present case, the petitioner seeks bail in connection with Madhepura (Ghailarh) P.S. Case No. 884 of 2025 dated 29.08.2025, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 126(2),
115(2), 137(2), 87, 76, 303(2), 352 and 351(2) read with Section 3(5) of the B.N.S., 2023.
3.
As per the prosecution case, petitioner and other co-accused persons entered into the house of the informant in night and forcibly took away the daughter of the informant.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

Prior to the lodging of the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.271 of 2026(3) dt.26-02-2026 present case, earlier two cases vide Madhepura (Ghailadh O.P.) P.S. Case No. 83 of 2024, under Sections 363, 376, 323, 341, 379, 354B and 34 of the IPC and Madhepura (Ghailadh O.P.) P.S. Case No. 766 of 2024, under Sections 127(1), 115(2), 137(1), 40(3),

sentences.text: The victim girl recorded her statement before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, wherein she stated that she was in love with this petitioner and went with him on her own.
She also stated that she was taken to Nepal and she was being forced by her mother to give statement against the petitioner.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner and the victim solemnized marriage and an affidavit to this effect was also made.

Learned counsel further submits that both the petitioner and the victim are major, but under pressure of her family the victim girl retracted from her statement and gave a statement against the petitioner when she was called by this Court in Cr.
WJC No. 2542 of 2025, by the Hon'ble Division Bench in a writ of Habeas Corpus, filed by this petitioner.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner has not committed any offence and the daughter of the informant went with the petitioner on her own and both have solemnized marriage.

Learned counsel next submits that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.271 of 2026(3)
dt.26-02-2026 petitioner is having antecedent of two cases in which he is on bail and chargesheet has been submitted.

Learned counsel lastly submits that petitioner is in custody since 02.09.2025.
5.
Learned A.P.P. appearing on behalf of the State as well as learned counsel for the informant oppose the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the informant submits that family of the informant is terrified by the petitioner who earlier forcibly took away the daughter of the informant and the petitioner has prepared some obscene video of the daughter of the informant and has been blackmailing her.
Learned counsel further submits that informant's family is in a weak position in the village and for this reason they are terrorized by the petitioner and others.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances and submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the voluntary nature of act of the daughter of the informant and also considering submission of chargesheet and period of custody of the petitioner, the petitioner, above-named, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhepura / concerned Court, in connection with Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.271 of 2026(3) dt.26-02-2026 Madhepura (Ghailarh) P.S. Case No. 884 of 2025, subject to the condition laid down under Section 480(3) of the B.N.S.S. and other following conditions:
(i) One of the bailors will be a close relative of the petitioner.
(ii) The petitioner will remain present on each and every date fixed by the court below, if so required by the learned trial Court.
(iii) In case of absence on three consecutive dates or in violation of the terms of the bail, the bail bond of the petitioner will be liable to be cancelled by the Court concerned.

(iv) If the petitioner is found involved in similar type of occurrence in future, the prosecution is at liberty to move for the cancellation of the bail bonds of the petitioner before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhepura.
